publicWarnings.publicWarningText:

2.	In accordance with section 45(1)(b) of the Act, a delegate has directed Meher International Pty Ltd to have a procedures register for the implemented for the business that complies with the requirements under the Act and Regulation by 26 February 2016.

3.	In accordance with section 45(1)(b) of the Act, a delegate imposed a condition on licence number MVRL50832 of Meher International Pty Ltd  comply with the directions of this Determination as a condition of the licence.


The determination took effect on 19 February 2016.
